name: pre-commit
html:
#!/usr/bin/env zsh
# luiskr.com pre-commit gate — deliberately fast:
#   1. prettier --write on every staged file (autofix, then re-stage)
#   2. TypeScript typecheck only. Tests and coverage belong to later gates.
#
# Runs in two contexts:
#   • superproject root — scoped typecheck across touched module areas;
#     bare gitlink bumps (link:<path>) typecheck nothing — the module's
#     own hooks already gated that commit.
#   • inside a module (submodule) — formats staged files and typechecks
#     only that module's tsconfig.
#
# Installed by shared/scripts/install-hooks.mjs → <repo>/.git/hooks/pre-commit
# (and into every submodule's hooks dir).

set -euo pipefail

SUPER="$(git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree 2>/dev/null || true)"

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

# ── 1. Format staged files and re-stage them ─────────────────────────────────
STAGED="$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -E '\.(js|mjs|cjs|ts|tsx|scss|css|json|md|yml|yaml|html)$' || true)"

if [[ -n "$STAGED" ]]; then
  echo "── pre-commit: prettier --write on staged files ──"
  # -s caps each invocation's argv bytes — an unbounded xargs batch can
  # exceed E2BIG on mega-commits (thousands of staged paths), and the
  # `yarn` wrapper makes it worse by re-spawning with the full env.
  # Calling the local binary directly is both safer and faster.
  PRETTIER_BIN="$SUPER${SUPER:+/}node_modules/.bin/prettier"
  [[ -x "$PRETTIER_BIN" ]] || PRETTIER_BIN="$PWD/node_modules/.bin/prettier"
  print -r -- "$STAGED" | xargs -s 65536 "$PRETTIER_BIN" --write --ignore-unknown
  # -f: every staged path is already tracked, but git>=2.4x rejects an
  # explicit pathspec that textually matches a .gitignore pattern (e.g.
  # tracked tests under an ignored `coverage/` dir) unless forced.
  print -r -- "$STAGED" | xargs -s 65536 git add -f --
fi

# ── 2. Typecheck ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [[ -n "$SUPER" ]]; then
  # Module context — only this module's own tsconfig; sibling modules and
  # the superproject belong to their own hooks/gates.
  echo "── pre-commit: module typecheck ($(basename "$PWD")) ──"
  if [[ -f tsconfig.json ]] && git diff --cached --name-only | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then
    yarn tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
  fi
  exit 0
fi

echo "── pre-commit: scoped TypeScript typecheck ──"
SCOPES="$(node shared/scripts/verify/scope-gates.mjs areas --staged)"

# Scope-less commits (docs-only, assets) skip compilation entirely; a
# toolchain/config change resolves to every scope.
if [[ -n "$SCOPES" ]]; then
  for scope in ${(s: :)SCOPES}; do
    case "$scope" in
      link:*) ;; # gitlink bump — the module's own commit was already gated
      app)   yarn tsc --noEmit ;;
      earth) yarn tsc -p "experiments/earth-playground/tsconfig.json" --noEmit ;;
      docs)  yarn tsc -p "experiments/docs/tsconfig.json" --noEmit ;;
      star-field) yarn tsc -p "experiments/star-field/tsconfig.json" --noEmit ;;
      *)     yarn tsc -p "$scope/tsconfig.json" --noEmit ;;
    esac
  done
fi
